items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Interviewee does not mention Cacha directly, only responding to interviewer's prompt about Cacha's arrival.

ctx.x: Ahh - Can't remember, I think we recorded after.
Okay. In May of '46, Chano Pozo, Cacha and Pepe Veque came to the United States. What do you remember about that?
Well, in that particular time we was at La Conga with Bert Longworth and when he got there, Miguelito Valdes and Diosa Costelo and Bobby Capo were ....
